en: Dependent on a root-conditioned state accompanied by rapture, there arises a non-root-conditioned state not accompanied by rapture by way of root-conditionality (*hetupaccaya*)... Three [answers] for root... pe ... three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a root-conditioned state accompanied by pleasure, there arises a non-root-conditioned state not accompanied by pleasure by way of root-conditionality... Three [answers] for root... pe ... three for non-disappearance.

Dependent on a root-conditioned state accompanied by equanimity, there arises a non-root-conditioned state not accompanied by equanimity by way of root-conditionality... Three [answers] for root... pe ... three for non-disappearance.
